headline: Personal guitar capo settings and clearer chord charts.
highlights: Guitarists can save a separate capo fret and on/off setting for each song without changing other musicians' charts.
Keep the band key visible while playing capo chord shapes, and restore your settings when reopening a song.
Notes stay on the selected verse occurrence, with redesigned private and team note cards and editors.
Chord charts use a wider, cleaner modal with hidden scrollbars and mobile song navigation at the bottom of short charts.
Includes notification preview fixes, event Team-tab improvements, and native desktop support in the shared source.
